newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Two dead in Albania jail riot - ministry source.
newsitem.headline: Two dead in Albania jail riot - ministry source.

text.p: Inmates at a jail in central Albania rioted and fought with prison guards in an attempt to break out of jail on Sunday evening and at least two prisoners were reported dead, an Interior Ministry source said on Monday.
Police reinforcements were called in to break up the riot in Bardhor jail, near Kavaje, 50 km (30 miles) west of Tirana, and the situation was now under control, the source said.

Several prisoners and police officers were injured in the fighting, Radio Tirana reported. It said at least one inmate had died. Three police officers were held hostage by inmates for a time until the riot was brought under control, it added.
"They were trying to exploit the tense situation created by protests around the country," the ministry source said.

The disturbance occurred the same day as protesters clashed with riot police in Tirana and angry crowds set fire to scores of government buildings in towns in the south in a wave of protests over collapsing get-rich-quick pyramid savings schemes.
On Sunday, Albania's parliament gave special powers to President Sali Berisha enabling him to deploy the military to guard strategic buildings and free roads blocked by protesters.
